svg.title: Figure 3-6. SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 5 of 10 (SWF)
svg.desc: SW FMEA failure chains, sheet 5 of 10 (SWF rev 0.9): failure modes SWF-038 to SWF-035 (7 failure modes, 12 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-6 · SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 5 of 10
SWF rev 0.9 · BL-005 · draft · SWF-038 … SWF-035 · 12 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
Enter overriding while the driver steers and
Lateral control keeps commanding torque while the driver
End effect: Item resists the driver's steering within the panda
By design, overriding counts as active (state.py:8, 43-45); controlsd
latcontrol_torque freezes only the integrator on steeringPressed…
Go to disabled in the same cycle on
selfdrived does not disengage on driver brake or cancel
End effect: Automation not released on brake or cancel by the
carState is read from its own socket with a 20 ms timeout and the
previous carState is reused when nothing arrives (selfdrived.py:83,
472-473); carState is not in the SubMaster, so it has no alive/freq…
Defect in the brake/gas rising-edge logic (selfdrived.py:253-256), in
the canValid gate on car events (selfdrived.py:242-244), or in the
USER_DISABLE priority of the state machine (state.py:31-33)
Raise fault and driver-action events from
Panda/host disagreement on safety mode or
controls-allowed detected late or not at all
End effect: Steering or ACC stops while the device shows
Defect in the BL-005 controlsMismatch supervision (supervision.py
ControlsMismatch: 2 consecutive pandaStates samples, at most 0.5
s from the first mismatched frame, samples in the first 0.3 s after…
Safety model, parameter and alternative-experience mismatch is
ignored for the first 10 s after selfdrived starts
Stale pandaStates (pandad stalled): the last message, with
controlsAllowed true, is reused, so the mismatch supervision does
not count; only commIssue after the 1 s alive window (10 Hz…
Detect PCM cruise active while not
PCM cruise active while selfdrived is not engaged, without
End effect: Stock cruise active without the driver knowing
At BL-004 cruiseMismatch had no reaction or alert and was raised
only after 6 s. Since #51 (BL-005) it is raised after 1 s
Raise the forward collision warning only
from fresh and valid modelV2 and
Forward collision warning raised from stale or invalid
End effect: Reflex hard braking by the driver with a close
The FCW condition reads the last received modelV2 and
longitudinalPlan; a held or invalid message keeps raising FCW in the
same cycle in which commIssue is raised (TSR-625 freshness gat…
Give each event the reaction type (no entry,
soft or immediate disable, user disable) and
A detected or reportable fault leads to no disable reaction
End effect: Item continues, or the panda stops it while the driver
Panda fault flags other than relayMalfunction get no reaction in
heartbeatLoopWatchdog, registerDivergent, ...), and SPI error bursts…
Defect in the BL-005 flag reactions: a wrong field, a missed panda
index, or the safetyTxBlocked baseline not moved after a panda
reset, so a flag the panda raises gives no disable…
Diagnostics masked on the big-model path: commIssue is
suppressed for every service while ChestnutLoading is set and for 5
s after, and posenet, locationd, paramsd and modeldLagging check…
Present the most urgent alert; every
Takeover request masked by a lower-urgency alert
End effect: Missing or late handback warning
Selection is by priority, then start frame (alertmanager.py:63).

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
